title: Valid Square
description: Determine if four given points can form a square.
pseudocode:
1. Calculate squared distances between all pairs of points
2. Store distances in a list
3. Sort the distances
4. A square exists if the 4 smallest distances (sides) are equal and > 0, and the 2 largest distances (diagonals) are equal and > 0

steps.note: Check sides (indices 0-3) are equal and > 0, and diagonals (indices 4-5) are equal and > 0. Valid square identified.
